Name: PKO-Native Procedural Knowledge Rulebook
Description: A canonical Effortless Rulebook profile aligned to the Procedural Knowledge Ontology (PKO) 2.0.0. It represents procedure specifications separately from executions and includes versioning, status changes, steps, transitions, actions, software functions, tools, requirements, verifications, resources, agents, roles in time, issues, errors, questions, feedback, FAQs, explanations, governance, tacit/implicit/explicit knowledge capture, operational data bindings, learning, and communication policy projections. PKO-native terms are mapped exactly; enterprise knowledge-governance additions are explicitly identified as ERB-PKO extensions.

EvaluationContexts.Description: The instant this rulebook's time-dependent witnesses are evaluated against. Modeled as data rather than wall-clock so every freshness, overdue, and validity answer is reproducible and auditable: asking the same question tomorrow yields the same answer. schema.name: Organization
schema.Description: Organization that owns the role.

schema.name: CurrentAgent
schema.Description: Current agent filling the role; history is retained in RoleAssignments.

schema.name: CurrentAgentKind
schema.Description: Agent category of the current role filler.

schema.name: Responsibility
schema.Description: Accountability and responsibility assigned to the role.

schema.name: ActiveAssignmentCount
schema.Description: Total number of assignment rows ever recorded against this role.

schema.name: CurrentlyCoveredAssignmentCount
schema.Description: Number of assignment rows for this role that are in force right now.

schema.name: HasNoCurrentHolder
schema.Description: TRUE when no assignment currently covers this role — the role is uncovered.

schema.name: CountOfAwaitedDecisions
schema.Description: How many change requests name this role as the deciding authority.

schema.name: CurrentAssignment
schema.Description: The RoleAssignments id of the assignment by which this role is currently held. Deliberately a raw identifier, not a relationship: RoleAssignments already points at Roles, so an FK back would make the two mutually dependent and this rulebook must stay acyclic.

schema.name: CurrentAssignmentValidFrom
schema.Description: Start of the currently-in-force assignment for this role.

schema.name: IsNonHumanHeld
schema.Description: TRUE when the role's current agent is an AI agent or automated pipeline.

schema.name: IsUngovernedNonHumanRole
schema.Description: TRUE when a role is pointed at a non-human agent but has no assignment row granting it.

schema.name: DepartedAssignmentCount
schema.Description: How many assignments to this role have ended.

schema.name: HasLostAHolder
schema.Description: Whether anyone has ever departed this role.

schema.name: IsVacatedRole
schema.Description: A role somebody departed and that nobody currently covers.

schema.name: UngroundedBoundaryCount
schema.Description: How many boundaries constrain this role on lapsed authority.

schema.name: IsGovernedByLapsedAuthority
schema.Description: TRUE when at least one constraint on this role rests on knowledge that is no longer valid.

schema.name: UnescalatedRefusalCount
schema.Description: How many refusals this role should have been told about and was not.

schema.name: UnauthorizedEnforcementAssignmentCount
schema.Description: How many current assignments of this role are unauthorized enforcement assignments.

schema.name: IsUngovernedEnforcementRole
schema.Description: TRUE when a role that enforces controls on others is held with no recorded authorization.

schema.name: SemanticTypeIri
schema.Description: Exact semantic type IRI for the role.

schema.name: SpecializesRole
schema.Description: Role this one specializes.

schema.name: SeniorityLevel
schema.Description: Senior, Deputy, or blank.

schema.name: RoleFamily
schema.Description: Family of roles doing the same kind of work.

schema.name: SpecializedRoleFamily
schema.Description: Family of the specialized role.

schema.name: SpecializationCount
schema.Description: Roles that specialize this one.

schema.name: HasSpecializations
schema.Description: TRUE when another role specializes this one.

schema.name: IsSeniorVariantNotSpecialization
schema.Description: TRUE when a senior version of a role is not recorded as a specialization of a role in its own family.

schema.name: OrganizationType
schema.Description: Kind of organization the role sits in.

schema.name: IsNotHousedInDepartment
schema.Description: TRUE when the role sits directly in a company or division rather than a department.

schema.name: CapabilityTagCount
schema.Description: Capability tags.

schema.name: ComplianceReviewTagCount
schema.Description: Compliance-review capability tags.

schema.name: HasComplianceReviewCapability
schema.Description: TRUE when the role carries the compliance-review capability.

schema.name: RoleMentionCount
schema.Description: Source mentions judged to mean this role.

schema.name: UnresolvedRoleMentionCount
schema.Description: Such mentions whose wording the role vocabulary does not resolve.

schema.name: IsMissedByPhraseQuery
schema.Description: TRUE when a query for this role through the role vocabulary misses a process that mentions it in other words.

schema.name: PreferredKnowledgeForm
schema.Description: Whether people in the role prefer knowledge as Prose or as a Diagram.

schema.name: EscalationBackupRole
schema.Description: Role that backs this one up on escalation.

schema.name: CurrentHolderName
schema.Description: Name of the person or system holding the role.

schema.name: BackupRoleHolder
schema.Description: Agent holding the escalation backup role.

schema.name: HasEscalationBackup
schema.Description: TRUE when the role names an escalation backup role.

schema.name: HasUnfilledEscalationBackup
schema.Description: TRUE when the escalation backup role has nobody in it.

schema.name: ReleaseApprovalStepCount
schema.Description: Production release approval gates assigned to the role.

schema.name: IsProductionReleaseApprover
schema.Description: TRUE for the role that approves production releases.

schema.name: ApprovalStepCount
schema.Description: Approval steps assigned to the role.

RoleAssignments.Description: Time-bounded records of agents holding roles. Maps to pro:RoleInTime and preserves assignment history instead of overwriting it.

schema.name: RoleAssignmentId
schema.Description: Stored logical identifier for one RoleAssignments row.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Human-readable calculated display alias for the RoleAssignments row.

schema.name: Role
schema.Description: Role held during the assignment.

schema.name: Agent
schema.Description: Agent holding the role.

schema.name: ValidFrom
schema.Description: Start of the assignment's valid-time interval.

schema.name: ValidTo
schema.Description: End of the assignment's valid-time interval; null means open-ended.

schema.name: Reason
schema.Description: Rationale for the assignment or reassignment.

schema.name: Status
schema.Description: Active, Superseded, Planned, or Revoked.

schema.name: EvaluationContext
schema.Description: The evaluation context this assignment's currency is judged under.

schema.name: AsOfInstant
schema.Description: The evaluation instant this assignment's currency is judged against.

schema.name: IsCurrent
schema.Description: TRUE when the assignment is valid now.

schema.name: CurrentAgentKey
schema.Description: Echoes the Agent id only while this assignment is current; empty otherwise. Lets a parent count CURRENT assignments with a single-criterion COUNTIFS, which is the only shape this transpiler translates correctly.

schema.name: IsCurrentlyValid
schema.Description: TRUE when this role assignment is active and has not lapsed.

schema.name: AgentRoleKey
schema.Description: Composite agent+role key, emitted only for currently-valid assignments.

schema.name: HasDeparted
schema.Description: TRUE when this role assignment has ended — the agent no longer holds the role.

schema.name: CoversNow
schema.Description: TRUE when this assignment is both status-Active and inside its valid-time window right now.

schema.name: RoleWhenCovering
schema.Description: Echoes the role id when this assignment is currently in force, blank otherwise.

schema.name: AgentKind
schema.Description: Whether the agent holding this assignment is Human, AIAgent, or AutomatedPipeline.

schema.name: IsNonHumanAssignment
schema.Description: TRUE when this assignment places a non-human agent into the role.

schema.name: SupersedesAssignment
schema.Description: The assignment this one replaced, if any.

schema.name: PredecessorAgentKind
schema.Description: Agent kind of the assignment this one superseded.

schema.name: IsHumanToNonHumanHandover
schema.Description: TRUE when this assignment handed a role from a human to a non-human agent.

schema.name: ApprovingAuthorityRole
schema.Description: Role that approved this assignment.

schema.name: AuthorizingChangeRequest
schema.Description: Change request under which this assignment was approved.

schema.name: IsUnauthorizedNonHumanAssignment
schema.Description: TRUE when a non-human agent holds this role with no approving authority recorded at all. An authority named without a change request is still an authority; the separate WasAuthorizedByChangeRequest column carries that weaker distinction.

schema.name: WasAuthorizedByChangeRequest
schema.Description: TRUE when this assignment's authorization is traceable to a change request, not merely to a named role. The stronger form of authorization, kept separate so the weaker one is not silently reported as unauthorized.

schema.name: DecisionCount
schema.Description: Decisions made under this assignment.

schema.name: OverriddenDecisionCount
schema.Description: Decisions made under this assignment that a human corrected or reversed.

schema.name: OverrideRatePercent
schema.Description: Percentage of decisions under this assignment that a human overrode.

schema.name: PredecessorOverrideRatePercent
schema.Description: Override rate of the assignment this one superseded.

schema.name: QualityRegressedVsPredecessor
schema.Description: TRUE when this assignment is overridden by humans more often than the assignment it replaced.

schema.name: DepartedRoleKey
schema.Description: Composite-key echo: the role this assignment covered when the assignment has ended, blank otherwise.

schema.name: MinimumDecisionsForComparison
schema.Description: The number of decisions below which an override-rate comparison is not considered evidentially meaningful for this role.

schema.name: PredecessorDecisionCount
schema.Description: How many decisions the superseded assignment produced.

schema.name: HasSufficientSample
schema.Description: TRUE when this assignment has produced enough decisions for its override rate to mean anything.

schema.name: PredecessorHasSufficientSample
schema.Description: TRUE when the predecessor assignment produced enough decisions to compare against.

schema.name: ComparisonIsEvidentiallySound
schema.Description: TRUE when both sides of the override-rate comparison rest on adequate samples.

schema.name: SingleOverrideSwingPercent
schema.Description: How many percentage points one additional override would move this assignment's rate. The fragility of the number.

schema.name: QualityVerdictIsUnsupported
schema.Description: TRUE when a quality verdict is being reported for this assignment on a sample too small to support it.

schema.name: IsUnmeasuredAutomationHandover
schema.Description: TRUE when a human-to-machine handover is operating without a statistically meaningful quality comparison behind it.

schema.name: ErrorCorrectionCount
schema.Description: How many of this assignment's decisions were overridden because they were wrong.

schema.name: ErrorRatePercent
schema.Description: Percentage of this assignment's decisions overridden as errors -- the override rate with reserved-judgment overrides removed.

schema.name: AuthorizationDecidedAt
schema.Description: When the approving authority actually granted this assignment. Empty when no authorization was ever recorded.

schema.name: AuthorizationReviewedAt
schema.Description: When the authorization for this assignment was last re-examined.

schema.name: AuthorizationReviewCadenceDays
schema.Description: How often this assignment's authorization is promised to be re-examined.

schema.name: HasDatedAuthorization
schema.Description: TRUE when this assignment carries both a named approving authority and the date they granted it.

schema.name: DaysSinceAuthorizationReview
schema.Description: How long since this assignment's authorization was last re-examined.

schema.name: AuthorizationIsOverdueForReview
schema.Description: TRUE when the promised re-examination interval has elapsed without a review.

schema.name: IsStandingUnreviewedAutomation
schema.Description: TRUE when a currently-active non-human assignment has been running past its authorization review date.

schema.name: IsUnconditionedAutomationHandover
schema.Description: TRUE when a human-to-machine handover was authorized with no promised review cadence at all -- granted once, permanently.

schema.name: MaxTolerableErrorRatePercent
schema.Description: The error rate at or above which this assignment must stop making decisions unaided.

schema.name: ExceedsTolerableErrorRate
schema.Description: TRUE when this assignment's error rate has reached the threshold set when it was authorized.

schema.name: BoundaryViolationCountForAssignment
schema.Description: How many decisions under this assignment violated an authority boundary.

schema.name: HasAnyBoundaryViolation
schema.Description: TRUE when any decision under this assignment crossed a boundary it was forbidden to cross.

schema.name: HasUngroundedGoverningBoundary
schema.Description: TRUE when at least one boundary constraining this assignment's role rests on lapsed knowledge.

schema.name: SuspensionConditionMet
schema.Description: TRUE when any pre-declared condition requiring this assignment to stop deciding unaided has been met.

schema.name: IsOperatingUnderMetSuspensionCondition
schema.Description: TRUE when a suspension condition has been met and the assignment is nonetheless still active and still deciding.

schema.name: HasDeclaredSuspensionCondition
schema.Description: TRUE when this assignment has any pre-declared condition under which it must stop at all.

schema.name: HasApprovingAuthority
schema.Description: TRUE when a role is recorded as having approved this assignment.

schema.name: HasAuthorizingChangeRequest
schema.Description: TRUE when a change request is recorded as the governance vehicle for this assignment.

schema.name: IsEnforcementRole
schema.Description: Whether this role's function is to enforce controls on other agents' actions.

schema.name: IsUnauthorizedEnforcementAgent
schema.Description: TRUE when a non-human agent enforces controls on others while holding no recorded authorization of its own.

schema.name: GovernanceEvidenceCount
schema.Description: How many independent governance artifacts back this assignment: an approving role, an authorizing change request.

schema.name: UnauthorizedEnforcementRoleKey
schema.Description: Echoes the role only for non-human assignments nobody authorized; empty otherwise.

schema.name: SemanticTypeIri
schema.Description: Exact class IRI for the assignment event.

schema.name: ForProcedureVersion
schema.Description: Procedure version the role is held for (pro:relatesTo).

schema.name: ScopedVersionStatus
schema.Description: Status of that version.

schema.name: IsScopedToRetiredVersion
schema.Description: TRUE when a current assignment is held for a version that is deprecated or archived.

schema.name: PredecessorValidTo
schema.Description: When the superseded assignment ended.

schema.name: PredecessorLacksValidityEnd
schema.Description: TRUE when an assignment supersedes one whose validity period was never closed.

schema.name: AgentVersionKey
schema.Description: Model version or employment key of the assigned agent.

schema.name: AgentRolePairKey
schema.Description: Agent and role, as one key, regardless of validity.

schema.name: IsOpenEnded
schema.Description: TRUE when the assignment has no end.

schema.name: RoleApprovalStepCount
schema.Description: Approval steps assigned to the role.

schema.name: ReceivesApprovalNoticesNow
schema.Description: TRUE when the assignment currently covers a role that approval steps are assigned to, so its agent is who approval notices go to.

schema.name: CommunityOfPracticeId
schema.Description: Stored logical identifier for one CommunitiesOfPractice row.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Human-readable calculated display alias for the CommunitiesOfPractice row.

schema.name: Label
schema.Description: Community's human-readable name.

schema.name: Organization
schema.Description: Organization hosting the community.

schema.name: StewardRole
schema.Description: Role accountable for convening and maintaining the community.

schema.name: Purpose
schema.Description: Shared practice and knowledge-transfer purpose.

schema.name: Cadence
schema.Description: Meeting or practice cadence.

schema.name: SemanticTypeIri
schema.Description: Extension class IRI.

schema.name: OwnVocabulary
schema.Description: The vocabulary the community speaks.

schema.name: Norms
schema.Description: The community's working norms.

schema.name: Origin
schema.Description: Grassroots, Mandated or PurchasedPlatform.

schema.name: OpenApprenticeshipPlaces
schema.Description: Apprenticeship places on offer.

schema.name: IsColocatedTrade
schema.Description: TRUE when the trade is concentrated in one place.

schema.name: HasOwnVocabularyAndNorms
schema.Description: TRUE when the community has its own vocabulary and stated norms.

schema.name: SharingEventCount
schema.Description: Know-how transfers inside the community.

schema.name: IsMandatedWithoutSharingNorm
schema.Description: TRUE when a community was mandated or bought and no sharing happens in it.

schema.name: InterconnectedKnowHowCount
schema.Description: Know-how in the community that builds on related know-how in the same community.

schema.name: PhysicalKnowHowCount
schema.Description: Know-how about physical work.

schema.name: DigitalKnowHowCount
schema.Description: Know-how about digital work.

schema.name: PersonCarriedKnowHowCount
schema.Description: Know-how carried by people.

schema.name: SpansPhysicalAndDigitalWithHumans
schema.Description: TRUE when the community's know-how spans physical and digital work and people still carry it.

schema.name: ExternalMemberCount
schema.Description: Members from other organizations.

schema.name: SpecialistMemberCount
schema.Description: Specialists among the members.

schema.name: EmployerMoveCount
schema.Description: Know-how carried by people changing employers inside the community.

schema.name: IsCrossFirmPracticeCluster
schema.Description: TRUE when members from several firms share practice, people move between firms, and specialists are at hand.

schema.name: RecentApprenticeshipCount
schema.Description: Apprenticeships started in the community within three years.

schema.name: IsCirculationEndingForLackOfApprentices
schema.Description: TRUE when know-how circulates by people moving between firms but offered apprenticeships go unfilled.

schema.name: AmbientAbsorptionCount
schema.Description: Know-how absorbed by non-practitioners living among the trade.

schema.name: HasAmbientTradeKnowHow
schema.Description: TRUE when a trade concentrated in one place passes know-how even to people who do not practise it.

Procedures.Description: Abstract, discoverable procedures. Each version is represented separately in ProcedureVersions. Maps to pko:Procedure and dcat:Resource.

schema.name: ProcedureId
schema.Description: Stored logical identifier for one Procedures row.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Human-readable calculated display alias for the Procedures row.

schema.name: Title
schema.Description: Human-readable title; maps to dcterms:title.

schema.name: ProcedureType
schema.Description: Procedure type; maps to pko:hasProcedureType.

schema.name: OwnerOrganization
schema.Description: Organization that owns the procedure.

schema.name: AdoptedByOrganization
schema.Description: Organization that adopts the procedure; maps to pko:isAdoptedBy.

schema.name: Purpose
schema.Description: Desired outcome and scope of the procedure.

schema.name: Target
schema.Description: Thing or population on which the procedure acts; maps to pko:hasProcedureTarget.

schema.name: IsTemplate
schema.Description: TRUE when the procedure is a reusable template; maps to pko:isTemplate.

schema.name: CurrentVersionKey
schema.Description: Current version identifier, mirrored structurally by ProcedureVersions.IsCurrent.

schema.name: SemanticTypeIri
schema.Description: Exact PKO class IRI.

schema.name: ExecutionCount
schema.Description: Recorded executions across every version of this procedure.

schema.name: TemplateProcedure
schema.Description: Template this procedure instantiates (pko:hasTemplate).

schema.name: RequiredByRegulation
schema.Description: Regulation that makes this procedure mandatory.

schema.name: IsTemplateInstance
schema.Description: TRUE when the procedure instantiates a template.

schema.name: TargetCount
schema.Description: Targets the procedure is about.

schema.name: AdoptionCount
schema.Description: Organizations that adopted the procedure.

schema.name: SpecifiedStepTotal
schema.Description: Steps specified across every version of the procedure.

schema.name: HasNoExplicitSteps
schema.Description: TRUE for a procedure that exists only as a title and documents: no version specifies a single step.

schema.name: CalledByStepCount
schema.Description: Steps of other procedures that invoke this one as a sub-procedure.

schema.name: IsNestedProcedure
schema.Description: TRUE when the procedure runs inside a larger procedure.

schema.name: FailureCriterionCount
schema.Description: Failure criteria.

schema.name: HasNoFailureCriterion
schema.Description: TRUE when nothing says what outcome counts as failure.

schema.name: LensViewCount
schema.Description: Stakeholder views of the procedure.

schema.name: PrivilegesSingleStakeholderView
schema.Description: TRUE when the procedure is organized for exactly one stakeholder lens.

schema.name: StepLevelViewCount
schema.Description: Views whose lens needs step-level detail.

schema.name: CategoryLevelViewCount
schema.Description: Views whose lens needs only the category.

schema.name: ProcedureTypeRank
schema.Description: Taxonomy rank of the procedure's type.

schema.name: ProcedureTypeDefinition
schema.Description: Definition of the procedure's type.

schema.name: HasStepAndCategoryResolutions
schema.Description: TRUE when the procedure can be shown both at step level and at its process-type category.

schema.name: IsMissingDemandedResolution
schema.Description: TRUE when a lens needs step-level detail the procedure does not have, or a category the procedure is not classified into.

schema.name: IsInconsistentlyCategorized
schema.Description: TRUE when a procedure has no type, is filed at a domain or group rank instead of a process type, or its type has no definition.

schema.name: StrategicAlignmentCount
schema.Description: Strategic alignments stated for the procedure.

schema.name: HasNoStatedReasonForExisting
schema.Description: TRUE when nothing ties the procedure to a mission, rationale or value.

schema.name: OutcomeMeasureCount
schema.Description: Outcome measures.

schema.name: UnlinkedMeasureCount
schema.Description: Outcome measures tied to no business outcome.

schema.name: MeasuresPerformanceWithoutBusinessLink
schema.Description: TRUE when the procedure is measured but no measure connects to a business outcome.

schema.name: HinderedByCount
schema.Description: Operations that work against this one.

schema.name: IsHinderedByAnotherOperation
schema.Description: TRUE when another operation works against this one.

schema.name: TypeDistinguishingFacet
schema.Description: Facet the procedure's type claims to distinguish by.

schema.name: TypeDistinguishingValue
schema.Description: Value the procedure's type claims its members share.

schema.name: MatchingDistinctionCount
schema.Description: Facet assignments giving the procedure the value its type claims.

schema.name: LacksTypeDistinction
schema.Description: TRUE when the procedure does not have the distinguishing value its grouping claims.

schema.name: LacksDistinctionTypeKey
schema.Description: Type key when the procedure lacks its type's distinction.

schema.name: ManagedVocabularyCount
schema.Description: Controlled vocabularies governing the procedure that have a governing role and an establishment date.

schema.name: LacksManagedControlledVocabulary
schema.Description: TRUE when a procedure with steps has no controlled vocabulary whose metadata is managed.

schema.name: ComplianceReviewStepCount
schema.Description: Steps performed by a role carrying the compliance-review capability.

schema.name: InvolvesComplianceReviewRole
schema.Description: TRUE when a compliance-review role takes part in the procedure.

schema.name: IsRegulatedButUnformalized
schema.Description: TRUE for a procedure a regulation requires that exists only as a title and documents.

schema.name: AgentIntendedCount
schema.Description: Agentic AI initiatives aimed at the procedure.

schema.name: IsTacitOnlyAgentTarget
schema.Description: TRUE for a procedure intended for agent execution that exists only as tacit knowledge.

schema.name: RepositoryEntryCount
schema.Description: Repository entries documenting the procedure.

schema.name: StaleEntryCount
schema.Description: Repository entries past their review interval.

schema.name: DepartedOnlyKnowHowCount
schema.Description: Know-how of the procedure held only by people who left.

schema.name: HasDecayedTransferChannel
schema.Description: TRUE when the procedure's documentation has gone stale or some of its know-how is held only by people who left.

schema.name: ExecutionFeedbackEntryCount
schema.Description: Repository entries that wrote back what an execution taught.

schema.name: IsExecutedWithoutFeedbackLoop
schema.Description: TRUE when the procedure is executed and nothing from execution was written back into its documentation.

schema.name: MachineAuthoredEntryCount
schema.Description: Repository entries written by AI agents or pipelines.

schema.name: PractitionerRelationshipCount
schema.Description: Collection relationships with practitioners on the procedure.

schema.name: IsCapturedByAutomationAlone
schema.Description: TRUE when the procedure's knowledge was captured by machines and no practitioner was engaged.

schema.name: UnengagedStakeholderCount
schema.Description: Stakeholder departments never engaged in shaping the procedure's knowledge.

schema.name: HasUnengagedStakeholder
schema.Description: TRUE when a stakeholder department of the procedure has not been engaged.

schema.name: RecentStarterCount
schema.Description: New starters on the procedure within 180 days.

schema.name: UntransferredVeteranKnowHowCount
schema.Description: Veteran know-how never transferred or captured.

schema.name: DepartingVeteranKnowHowCount
schema.Description: Untransferred veteran know-how whose holder leaves soon.

schema.name: HasTransferShortfallExposure
schema.Description: TRUE when a wave of three or more new starters meets untransferred veteran know-how, or a departing veteran leaves know-how untransferred.

schema.name: ProficientWithCaptureCount
schema.Description: Proficient starters who learned from captured knowledge.

schema.name: ProficientWithoutCaptureCount
schema.Description: Proficient starters who learned without captured knowledge.

schema.name: DaysWithCaptureTotal
schema.Description: Total days to proficiency with captured knowledge.

schema.name: DaysWithoutCaptureTotal
schema.Description: Total days to proficiency without captured knowledge.

schema.name: AvgDaysToProficiencyWithCapture
schema.Description: Average days to proficiency with captured knowledge.

schema.name: AvgDaysToProficiencyWithoutCapture
schema.Description: Average days to proficiency without captured knowledge.

schema.name: FormalizationDoesNotEaseOnboarding
schema.Description: TRUE when starters who learned from captured knowledge took at least as long as those who did not.

schema.name: CollectedMaterialCount
schema.Description: Materials collected about the procedure.

schema.name: InWorkCaptureCount
schema.Description: Of those, materials captured in the course of executing the work.

schema.name: IsCaptureSeparateFromWork
schema.Description: TRUE when knowledge about the procedure is collected, but never in the course of the work.

schema.name: ExpertAcquisitionHours
schema.Description: Expert hours spent capturing knowledge about the procedure.

schema.name: ComplianceDocumentCount
schema.Description: Documents kept for compliance with this procedure, separate from how the work is done.

ProcedureVersions.Description: Versioned procedure specifications. Maps to pko:Procedure plus DCAT version relations and PKO versionNumber/newVersionMotivation/changelogDescription.

schema.name: ProcedureVersionId
schema.Description: Stored logical identifier for one ProcedureVersions row.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Human-readable calculated display alias for the ProcedureVersions row.

schema.name: Procedure
schema.Description: Abstract procedure of which this is a version.

schema.name: VersionNumber
schema.Description: Version number; maps to pko:versionNumber.

schema.name: Title
schema.Description: Version-specific title.

schema.name: Status
schema.Description: PKO procedure status individual: Draft, Validation, Approval, Approved, Deprecated, or Archived.

schema.name: IssuedAt
schema.Description: Issue timestamp; maps to dcterms:issued.

schema.name: ModifiedAt
schema.Description: Last semantic modification; maps to dcterms:modified.

schema.name: CreatedByAgent
schema.Description: Agent that created the version; maps to dcterms:creator.

schema.name: ModifiedByAgent
schema.Description: Agent that last modified the version; maps to pko:wasModifiedBy.

schema.name: NewVersionMotivation
schema.Description: Reason for the new version; maps to pko:newVersionMotivation.

schema.name: ChangelogDescription
schema.Description: Semantic change description; maps to pko:changelogDescription.

schema.name: IsCurrent
schema.Description: TRUE when this is the current version.

schema.name: CountOfSteps
schema.Description: Number of steps in this version.

schema.name: CountOfOpenKnowledgeGaps
schema.Description: Open knowledge gaps for this version.

schema.name: IsReadyForExecution
schema.Description: TRUE when approved, populated, and free of blocking knowledge gaps.

schema.name: SpecifiedStepCount
schema.Description: How many steps the specification defines for this version.

schema.name: OverdueReviewCount
schema.Description: How many reviews of this procedure version are past due.

schema.name: OpenChangeRequestCount
schema.Description: How many change requests are open against this version.

schema.name: OpenHighSeverityGapCount
schema.Description: How many high-severity knowledge gaps are open against this version.

schema.name: IsFitToExecute
schema.Description: TRUE when this version is approved, current on review, and carries no open change request or high-severity gap.

schema.name: StewardReviewCadenceDays
schema.Description: The review cadence promised by this version's stewardship assignment, in days. Summed because a version has at most one active steward; this is the hop that lets ReviewEvents resolve the promise via a primary-key match.

schema.name: CountOfStewardshipAssignments
schema.Description: How many stewardship assignments of any vintage point at this version.

schema.name: HasAnySteward
schema.Description: TRUE if any stewardship assignment has ever named this version.

schema.name: IsLive
schema.Description: TRUE when this version is in a state where somebody could execute it.

schema.name: IsUnstewarded
schema.Description: TRUE when no stewardship assignment names this version.

schema.name: IsLiveAndUnstewarded
schema.Description: TRUE when an executable version has nobody accountable for keeping it healthy.

schema.name: CountOfOpenBlockingGaps
schema.Description: How many open blocking gaps stand against this version.

schema.name: HasOpenBlockingGap
schema.Description: TRUE when at least one open blocking gap stands against this version.

schema.name: IsLiveWithBlockingGap
schema.Description: TRUE when an executable version carries an unresolved blocking knowledge gap.

schema.name: ShouldNotBeExecutable
schema.Description: TRUE when the model says this version is ready to execute while a blocking gap is open against it.

schema.name: CountOfUnapprovedRelianceFragments
schema.Description: How many unapproved claims this version is relying on.

schema.name: RunsOnUnapprovedKnowledge
schema.Description: TRUE when this version depends on at least one claim the knowledge authority has not approved.

schema.name: CountOfOverdueGaps
schema.Description: How many acknowledged unknowns against this version have outlived their tolerance.

schema.name: CountOfChangeRequests
schema.Description: How many change requests have ever been raised against this version.

schema.name: CountOfReviewEvents
schema.Description: How many review events have ever been recorded against this version.

schema.name: HasGovernanceRecord
schema.Description: TRUE when at least one change request or review event exists for this version.

schema.name: EvaluationContext
schema.Description: The evaluation context this row's time-dependent witnesses are judged under.

schema.name: AsOfInstant
schema.Description: The evaluation instant this row's time-dependent witnesses are judged against.

schema.name: DaysSinceModified
schema.Description: Days since this version's content was last changed.

schema.name: DaysSinceLastReview
schema.Description: Days since the most recent review of this version.

schema.name: WasModifiedSinceLastReview
schema.Description: TRUE when the version was edited more recently than it was reviewed.

schema.name: ModifierIsAuthority
schema.Description: The kind of agent that last modified this version.

schema.name: HasUnwitnessedChange
schema.Description: TRUE when a live version's current content postdates every review it has had.

schema.name: CountOfStaleFragments
schema.Description: How many supporting claims have outlived this version's review cadence.

schema.name: KnowledgeIsStalerThanCadence
schema.Description: TRUE when this version rests on at least one claim older than its own review cadence.

schema.name: CompoundFragileFragmentCount
schema.Description: How many compound-fragile knowledge fragments this version rests on.

schema.name: RestsOnCompoundFragileKnowledge
schema.Description: A live procedure version resting on at least one knowledge fragment that carries three or more decay signals.

schema.name: ConcentratedWitnessSessionCount
schema.Description: How many concentrated single-witness sessions underwrite this version's knowledge base.

schema.name: KnowledgeBaseIsConcentrated
schema.Description: A live version where at least one single-witness session alone underwrites three or more of its live claims.

schema.name: MachineConsumedUnapprovedCount
schema.Description: How many unapproved claims this version feeds directly to software-assigned steps.

schema.name: FeedsUnapprovedKnowledgeToMachines
schema.Description: A live version that hands unapproved knowledge to a step no human is positioned to review.

schema.name: GenuinelyOverdueFragmentCount
schema.Description: How many of this version's claims are overdue by actual review record rather than by inference.

schema.name: AwaitedDecisionCount
schema.Description: How many decisions are pending against this live version.

schema.name: ScopedOpenBlockingGapCount
schema.Description: How many open blocking gaps belong to THIS version, correctly scoped.

schema.name: IsBlockedOnPendingDecision
schema.Description: A live version carrying both an undecided change request and an open blocking gap — the gap cannot close until the decision lands.

schema.name: UnexercisedHumanGateCount
schema.Description: How many of this version's human-only gates have never been approached by software.

schema.name: AiBoundaryIsUnevidenced
schema.Description: A live version whose human-only gates rest on assertion rather than on any observed attempt by software.

schema.name: LoadBearingUnapprovedCount
schema.Description: How many high-blast-radius unapproved claims this version rests on.

schema.name: UnlandedDecisionCount
schema.Description: How many decided-but-unimplemented change requests hold this version's fitness down.

schema.name: UnrehearsedControlEntryCount
schema.Description: How many unrehearsed control entries exist in this procedure version.

schema.name: HasUnrehearsedControlEntry
schema.Description: Whether this live version has at least one blocking control that is only reachable by a path nobody has ever walked.

schema.name: IsLiveWithUnrehearsedControl
schema.Description: A version that is live for execution while carrying at least one never-rehearsed blocking control entry.

schema.name: CadenceBreachCount
schema.Description: How many review events on this version are past their promised cadence.

schema.name: IsInCadenceBreach
schema.Description: Whether this version currently has at least one review event past the cadence its steward promised.

schema.name: HasDecisionInFlight
schema.Description: Whether this version has at least one change request that is still open.

schema.name: IsUnremediatedCadenceBreach
schema.Description: A cadence breach with no open change request against the version — a broken promise with no response in motion.

schema.name: IsManagedCadenceBreach
schema.Description: A cadence breach where a change request is at least open against the version.

schema.name: GovernanceIsSilent
schema.Description: A live version with neither a change request nor a review event ever recorded against it.

schema.name: ValidFragmentCount
schema.Description: How many currently-valid knowledge fragments are attached to this version.

schema.name: StillOwnsValidKnowledge
schema.Description: Whether this version still holds at least one knowledge fragment that is currently valid.

schema.name: IncomingSupersessionCount
schema.Description: How many other versions declare that they supersede this one.

schema.name: IsStillReferenced
schema.Description: Whether any other version points at this one through a supersession link.

schema.name: IsLoadBearingOrphan
schema.Description: An unstewarded version that is still referenced by a supersession link or still owns currently-valid knowledge — nobody is accountable for it and something still depends on it.

schema.name: IsCleanlyRetired
schema.Description: An unstewarded version that nothing depends on — a genuine, safe retirement.

schema.name: StalledImplementationCount
schema.Description: How many approved-but-unimplemented change requests are stalled against this version.

schema.name: IsHeldUnfitByLandedDecisions
schema.Description: A version reading unfit to execute specifically because approved changes have not been marked implemented.

schema.name: UndeclaredControlKindCount
schema.Description: How many steps in this version have not declared a control kind.

schema.name: ControlTaxonomyIsIncomplete
schema.Description: Whether this version contains any step whose control kind is unstated — meaning role-based and id-based control predicates cannot be trusted to cover it.

schema.name: HasApprovedChangeRequest
schema.Description: TRUE when at least one change request against this version has been approved.

schema.name: ApprovedChangeRequestCount
schema.Description: How many change requests against this version have been approved.

schema.name: UnwatchedUnownedControlCount
schema.Description: How many blocking controls in the model are neither computed nor owned.

schema.name: MiningRunCount
schema.Description: How many process-mining conformance runs exist for this procedure version.

schema.name: DriftedMiningRunCount
schema.Description: How many mining runs found major, real drift while this version was live.

schema.name: HasUnresolvedMiningDrift
schema.Description: TRUE when mined operational evidence contradicts this live version's documented path.

schema.name: EntryStepId
schema.Description: The step this procedure version starts at: the one step no transition leads into.

schema.name: SemanticTypeIri
schema.Description: Exact PKO class IRI.

schema.name: ExecutionCount
schema.Description: Recorded executions of this procedure version.

schema.name: ExpectedDurationValue
schema.Description: Expected duration, numeric part (time:numericDuration).

schema.name: ExpectedDurationUnit
schema.Description: Expected duration unit (time:unitType).

schema.name: StatusIsPko
schema.Description: Whether the version's status is a PKO 2.0.0 procedure status.

schema.name: UsesNonPkoStatus
schema.Description: TRUE when the version holds a status PKO does not define.

schema.name: ExceptionCount
schema.Description: Documented exceptions.

schema.name: FallbackTransitionCount
schema.Description: Fallback transitions.

schema.name: AlternativeTransitionCount
schema.Description: Alternative transitions.

schema.name: HasNoExceptionHandling
schema.Description: TRUE when a version with steps captures only the normative path: no exception, fallback or alternative.

schema.name: LatestSourceDocumentModifiedAt
schema.Description: Most recent modification of any document the version references.

schema.name: DaysDocumentTrailsVersion
schema.Description: Days by which the referenced documents trail the version's own last change.

schema.name: DocumentLagsPractice
schema.Description: TRUE when the documents a version rests on have not changed for more than sixty days of changes to the version itself.

schema.name: HumanStepCount
schema.Description: Steps whose role is held by a person.

schema.name: NonHumanStepCount
schema.Description: Steps whose role is held by software or AI.

schema.name: MixesHumanAndSoftwareSteps
schema.Description: TRUE when one version mixes human steps with software or AI steps.

schema.name: DayRunCount
schema.Description: Executions on the day shift.

schema.name: NightRunCount
schema.Description: Executions on the night shift.

schema.name: DayDeviatingRunCount
schema.Description: Day-shift executions with a step deviation.

schema.name: NightDeviatingRunCount
schema.Description: Night-shift executions with a step deviation.

schema.name: IsInconsistentAcrossShifts
schema.Description: TRUE when one shift runs the version cleanly and the other deviates.

schema.name: OverlapsRelationCount
schema.Description: Overlaps relations among the version's steps.

schema.name: EnablesRelationCount
schema.Description: Enables relations among the version's steps.

schema.name: PreventsRelationCount
schema.Description: Prevents relations among the version's steps.

schema.name: StepsWithoutOntologyTypeCount
schema.Description: Steps carried over from a notation with no ontology type.

schema.name: RestsOnNotationOnly
schema.Description: TRUE when some steps of the version carry no ontology type, so they mean nothing outside the diagram they came from.

schema.name: IsCurrentWithoutMotivation
schema.Description: TRUE for a current version that never recorded why it was created.

schema.name: ConditionlessStepCount
schema.Description: Steps with no precondition.

schema.name: IsUnderSpecifiedForExecution
schema.Description: TRUE when a version cannot tell an executor what must hold, or what to do when things go wrong: no steps, no step with a precondition, or no exception handling.

schema.name: CoarseTopLevelStepCount
schema.Description: Top-level steps written at Activity detail.

schema.name: FineTopLevelStepCount
schema.Description: Top-level steps written at Action detail.

schema.name: MixesGranularityAtOneLevel
schema.Description: TRUE when one level of a version mixes whole activities with single actions, so detail is weighted unevenly.

schema.name: ProcedureTypeOfVersion
schema.Description: Procedure type.

schema.name: CreatedByAgentKind
schema.Description: Kind of agent that created the version.

schema.name: ElicitationSessionCount
schema.Description: Elicitation sessions behind the version.

schema.name: ExpertCaptureCount
schema.Description: Capture-form submissions authored by domain experts.

schema.name: ElicitationEvidenceCount
schema.Description: Sessions plus expert captures: evidence tacit knowledge was elicited.

schema.name: IndexedSegmentCount
schema.Description: Retrieval segments served from the version: how rich it is for AI.

schema.name: SearchCount
schema.Description: Searches made while working with the version.

schema.name: SuccessfulSearchCount
schema.Description: Searches that found something useful.

schema.name: SearchSuccessPercent
schema.Description: How findable the version is.

schema.name: OpenQuestionAnnotationCount
schema.Description: Open clarifying questions practitioners attached: how unclear it is.

schema.name: IsInadequateForUse
schema.Description: TRUE when a version is too thin to guide AI, hard to find, or unclear to collaborators.

schema.name: ServedAssertionCount
schema.Description: Graph assertions served from the version.

schema.name: LacksMachineInterpretableEncoding
schema.Description: TRUE for a current version with no retrieval segments for search or no graph assertions for reasoning and AI.

schema.name: StructuredQueryCount
schema.Description: Structured queries over the version.

schema.name: ProfileValidatedSubmissionCount
schema.Description: Submissions of the version that validated against the PKO profile.

schema.name: ReasonedAssertionCount
schema.Description: Served assertions of the version in a snapshot a reasoner found consistent.

schema.name: IsNotQueryValidateReasonReady
schema.Description: TRUE for a current version that no structured query reads, no profile validation passed, or no reasoner has checked.

schema.name: PublishedProjectionCount
schema.Description: Published documents and diagrams of the version.

schema.name: ConsumerSyncCount
schema.Description: Consuming systems holding the version.

schema.name: IsUnreachableKnowledge
schema.Description: TRUE for a current version nobody can reach: no published projection and no consuming system.

schema.name: HumanSyncCount
schema.Description: Systems read by people that hold the version.

schema.name: MachineSyncCount
schema.Description: Systems read by AI that hold the version.

schema.name: HumanChannelCount
schema.Description: Ways people receive the version.

schema.name: MachineChannelCount
schema.Description: Ways machines receive the version.

schema.name: ServesOnlyHumansOrOnlyMachines
schema.Description: TRUE for a current version conveyed to people or to machines, but not both.

schema.name: FreshMiningRunCount
schema.Description: Process-mining conformance runs within the freshness window.

schema.name: LacksContinuousDriftDetection
schema.Description: TRUE for a current, executed version with no recent automated check of enacted against documented process.

schema.name: OutcomeMeasurementCount
schema.Description: Operational outcome measurements linked to the version.

schema.name: IsDisconnectedFromOutcomes
schema.Description: TRUE for a current, executed version no operational outcome is linked to.

schema.name: AiContributionCount
schema.Description: AI insights proposed about the version.

schema.name: AiConsumptionCount
schema.Description: Assertions and segments of the version served to AI.

schema.name: UsesAiInOneDirectionOnly
schema.Description: TRUE when AI only consumes the version and never contributes to it, or only contributes and never consumes it.

schema.name: IsUnmodifiedForTwelveMonths
schema.Description: TRUE for a current workflow not modified in more than twelve months.

schema.name: DesignDecisionCount
schema.Description: Design decisions recorded with the version.

schema.name: IsLiveWithoutRecordedDecisions
schema.Description: TRUE for a live version with no design decision recorded alongside it.

schema.name: AiArtifactConsumingInputCount
schema.Description: Inputs of the version's steps fed by an AI agent's artifact.

schema.name: ContainsStepsAffectedByAiAgentChange
schema.Description: TRUE when the workflow contains a step that consumes an AI agent's artifact, so changing that agent affects it.

schema.name: InterviewSessionCount
schema.Description: Interview sessions for the version.

schema.name: ObservationSessionCount
schema.Description: Observation sessions for the version.

schema.name: WorkshopSessionCount
schema.Description: Workshop sessions for the version.

schema.name: ProtocolSessionCount
schema.Description: Think-aloud, retrospective, laddering and grid sessions for the version.

schema.name: IncidentSessionCount
schema.Description: Critical incident sessions for the version.

schema.name: ReconciledDivergenceCount
schema.Description: Workflow disagreements settled for the version.

schema.name: ComplementaryMethodCount
schema.Description: Distinct families of elicitation used for the version.

schema.name: ReliesOnSingleMethod
schema.Description: TRUE when the version's knowledge was elicited with one family of method only.

schema.name: MissesARequiredElicitationMode
schema.Description: TRUE for an elicited version lacking a workshop, a structured interview, observation, or a session that settled a disagreement.

schema.name: CriticalIncidentCount
schema.Description: Critical incidents collected for the version.

schema.name: JudgmentUnprobedByIncidents
schema.Description: TRUE when a version relies on tacit or situated judgment yet no critical incident was collected to surface it.

schema.name: SmeApprovalCount
schema.Description: Approvals of the representation by subject matter experts it affects.

schema.name: SmeAiEvaluationCount
schema.Description: Evaluations of AI output on this version by affected subject matter experts.

schema.name: IsApprovedWithoutSmeSignoff
schema.Description: TRUE for an approved version no affected subject matter expert approved the representation of.

schema.name: ExpertsEvaluateAiNotRepresentation
schema.Description: TRUE when experts were recruited to evaluate AI output on a version but none to approve the representation it rests on.

schema.name: KeSessionCount
schema.Description: Sessions the knowledge engineer ran for the version.

schema.name: KeFieldSessionCount
schema.Description: Sessions the knowledge engineer ran where the work is done.

schema.name: IsStudiedOnlyFromTheDesk
schema.Description: TRUE when the knowledge engineer elicited the version but never went where the work happens.

schema.name: JudgmentHeldOutsideSopCount
schema.Description: Unformalized knowledge of the version its SOP says nothing about.

schema.name: TacitHoldingCount
schema.Description: Holdings of the version in tacit form.

schema.name: ExplicitHoldingCount
schema.Description: Holdings of the version in explicit form.

schema.name: TacitShareExceedsExplicit
schema.Description: TRUE when more of the version's knowledge is held tacitly than in explicit carriers.

schema.name: HandsHeldCount
schema.Description: Unformalized knowledge held only in operators' memory.

schema.name: NegotiatedPracticeCount
schema.Description: Unformalized knowledge held as unspoken crew agreements.

schema.name: LivesInHandsSilenceAndNegotiation
schema.Description: TRUE when the version's knowledge lives at once in experienced hands, in what its SOP leaves unsaid, and in unspoken crew agreements.

schema.name: ProcessModelTraceCount
schema.Description: Origin traces of the version as a process model.

schema.name: IsLiveModelUntraced
schema.Description: TRUE when an executable process model traces to no collection activity.

schema.name: TrailingPracticeTraceCount
schema.Description: Contradictions showing a document of this version trailing practice.

schema.name: IsDocumentedBehindPractice
schema.Description: TRUE when the version's documentation trails how the work is performed.

schema.name: StandardizationDriver
schema.Description: Why the version was standardized: Compliance or Practice.

schema.name: TacitFragmentCount
schema.Description: Tacit knowledge fragments captured for the version.

schema.name: IsStandardizedWithoutTacitCapture
schema.Description: TRUE when a version standardized for compliance has no tacit knowledge captured behind it.

schema.name: TacitFormFragmentCount
schema.Description: Tacit fragments attached to the version.

schema.name: SituatedJudgmentFragmentCount
schema.Description: Situated-judgment fragments attached to the version.

schema.name: TacitJudgmentFragmentCount
schema.Description: Tacit or situated-judgment fragments attached to the version.

schema.name: FirstStep
schema.Description: Declared first step (pko:hasFirstStep), read from the step that declares itself first.

schema.name: FallbackStep
schema.Description: Declared fallback step (pko:hasFallbackStep), read from the step that declares itself the fallback.

schema.name: FirstStepDisagreesWithGraph
schema.Description: TRUE when the transition graph has an entry step and the declared first step is a different one. A graph whose first step also receives a loop-back has no entry step, and is not a disagreement.

schema.name: DeclaredFirstStepCount
schema.Description: Steps of the version that declare themselves its first step.

schema.name: GraphEntryStepCount
schema.Description: Steps of the version with no incoming transition.

schema.name: OwnerOrganization
schema.Description: The organization that owns the procedure this row belongs to, one hop at a time from Procedures.OwnerOrganization. A row policy compares it to the caller's organization, so a plant sign-in never sees the finance close.

schema.name: NextProcedureVersion
schema.Description: Later version.

schema.name: RelationIri

schema.name: ChangeSummary
schema.Description: Summary of semantic change across the edge.

schema.name: SupersededVersionKey
schema.Description: Echoes the superseded (previous) version id for rows that express a next-version relation. Supersession is carried by RelationIri here, not by a separate link-kind column.

schema.name: ProcedureStatusChangeId

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Human-readable calculated display alias for the ProcedureStatusChanges row.

schema.name: ProcedureVersion
schema.Description: Procedure version whose status changed.

schema.name: FromStatus
schema.Description: Previous PKO status.

schema.name: ToStatus
schema.Description: New PKO status.

schema.name: ChangedAt
schema.Description: Time of change; maps to prov:atTime.

schema.name: ChangedByAgent
schema.Description: Agent responsible for the change.

schema.name: Motivation
schema.Description: Reason for changing status.

schema.name: SemanticTypeIri
schema.Description: Exact PKO class IRI.

schema.name: ChangeKind

schema.name: ProcedureExecution
schema.Description: Execution the change applies to, when it is not a version change.

schema.name: IsUnattributedChange
schema.Description: TRUE when nobody is recorded as making the change.

schema.name: ChangeKindContradictsTarget
schema.Description: TRUE when the kind of change does not match the status it moved to.

Steps.Description: Version-scoped units of work. Atomic steps map to pplan:Step; composite steps map to pplan:MultiStep. The specification is never conflated with execution.

schema.name: StepId
schema.Description: Stored logical identifier for one Steps row.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Human-readable calculated display alias for the Steps row.

schema.name: ProcedureVersion
schema.Description: Procedure version containing the step; maps to pko:hasStep/pplan:isStepOfPlan.

schema.name: StepNumber
schema.Description: Stable sequence label; maps to pko:stepNumber.

schema.name: Title
schema.Description: Human-readable step title.

schema.name: StepKind
schema.Description: Atomic or MultiStep.

schema.name: AssignedRole
schema.Description: Role responsible for the step.

schema.name: AssignedRoleLabel
schema.Description: Resolved role label.

schema.name: AssignedAgentKind
schema.Description: Current role-filler category.

schema.name: Instruction
schema.Description: Normative step instruction.

schema.name: ExpectedDurationMinutes
schema.Description: Expected duration represented as an OWL-Time duration in semantic projections.

schema.name: ExpertiseLevel
schema.Description: PKO expertise level: Junior, Senior, Expert, or Master.

schema.name: RequiresHumanConfirmation
schema.Description: TRUE when a human must confirm the step; maps to pko:wasConfirmedBy at execution.

schema.name: BlockingRequirementCount
schema.Description: How many blocking requirements the specification attaches to this step.

schema.name: StaleBindingCount
schema.Description: How many operational bindings for this step are currently outside their freshness SLA.

schema.name: AuthoritativeStaleCount
schema.Description: How many authoritative bindings for this step are currently stale.

schema.name: AvailableExceptionCount
schema.Description: How many active exceptions the specification defines for this step.

schema.name: DeclaredVerificationCount
schema.Description: How many verifications the specification declares for this step.

schema.name: IsPreparationStep
schema.Description: TRUE for steps whose assigned role produces the work product rather than reviewing it.

schema.name: IsApprovalStep
schema.Description: TRUE for steps whose assigned role is an approval authority.

schema.name: StaleAuthoritativeBindingCount
schema.Description: Number of authoritative bindings for this step that are past their freshness SLA.

schema.name: InputsAreFresh
schema.Description: TRUE when no authoritative binding for this step is stale.

schema.name: IsSoftwareAssigned
schema.Description: TRUE when this step is specified to be performed by software rather than a person.

schema.name: IsHumanApprovalGate
schema.Description: TRUE for the steps that exist specifically to place a human commitment between drafting and delivery.

schema.name: GateHeldByHuman
schema.Description: TRUE when a designated approval gate is in fact assigned to a human role.

schema.name: BindingBoundaryCount
schema.Description: Number of authority boundaries currently binding at this step.

schema.name: AssignedRoleIsUngoverned
schema.Description: Whether this step's assigned role is a non-human role with no governing assignment.

schema.name: UnusableBindingCount
schema.Description: Number of bindings at this step that are unapproved or stale.

schema.name: AllSourcesUsable
schema.Description: TRUE when every binding at this step is an approved, fresh source.

schema.name: ControlKind
schema.Description: What kind of control this step is: Preparation, Approval, LegalReview, Verification, Extraction, Publication, Retrospective, or None. That policy-04 is a legal review is a property OF policy-04, not of a formula that happens to name it; storing it as data makes downstream predicates portable to procedures that do not exist yet.

schema.name: UnwarrantedBoundaryCount
schema.Description: How many boundaries governing this step are being enforced without a valid ratifying claim.

schema.name: IsGovernedByUnwarrantedBoundary
schema.Description: Whether this step's constraints on machine authority rest on a claim that is no longer valid.

schema.name: SoftwareExecutionCount
schema.Description: How many times a software agent has actually executed this step.

schema.name: HasBeenApproachedBySoftware
schema.Description: Whether any software agent has ever executed this step.

schema.name: IsUnexercisedHumanGate
schema.Description: A human-only approval gate that no software agent has ever attempted — the control is asserted, not demonstrated.

schema.name: IsDemonstratedHumanGate
schema.Description: A human gate that software has actually reached and that a human nevertheless held.

schema.name: UnexercisedGateVersionKey
schema.Description: Composite-key echo: this step's procedure version when the step is an unexercised human gate, blank otherwise.

schema.name: HasDeclaredControlKind
schema.Description: Whether this step declares what kind of control it is.

schema.name: UndeclaredControlVersionKey
schema.Description: Composite-key echo: this step's procedure version when the step has no declared control kind, blank otherwise.

schema.name: ApprovalStepIsSoftwareAssigned
schema.Description: An approval-kind step whose assigned role is currently held by an AI agent or automated pipeline.

schema.name: UnwitnessedBlockingCount
schema.Description: How many blocking controls bound to this step have no computed witness.

schema.name: ReachableStepCount
schema.Description: Number of steps this step can lead to through one or more transitions, including itself when it lies on a rework loop.

schema.name: ReachedFromStepCount
schema.Description: Number of steps that can lead to this step through one or more transitions, including itself when it lies on a rework loop.

schema.name: SelfReachCount
schema.Description: 1 when the closure contains the pair (this step, this step), i.e. some path of one or more transitions returns to this step; otherwise 0.

schema.name: IsOnReworkLoop
schema.Description: The procedure can send work back to this step after it has run: the step lies on a cycle of the step graph.

schema.name: IsBlockingControlOnReworkLoop
schema.Description: A step carrying at least one blocking requirement can be re-entered, so that control must hold on every pass, not only the first.

schema.name: IncomingTransitionCount
schema.Description: Number of transitions, of any kind, that lead into this step.

schema.name: IsEntryStep
schema.Description: No transition leads into this step: the procedure version starts here.

schema.name: EntryStepKey
schema.Description: Composite-key echo: this step's id when it is its procedure version's entry step, blank otherwise.

schema.name: VersionEntryStepId
schema.Description: The entry step of this step's procedure version.

schema.name: GateFreeReachFromEntryCount
schema.Description: 1 when some route of one or more gate-free transitions leads from the procedure version's entry step to this step; otherwise 0.

schema.name: IsReachableFromEntryWithoutHumanGate
schema.Description: Work can arrive at this step from the start of the procedure without passing any human approval gate.

schema.name: IsGateBypassedPublication
schema.Description: A publication step the procedure can reach without human sign-off: the approval gate is structurally bypassable.

schema.name: SemanticTypeIri
schema.Description: Exact P-Plan class IRI.

schema.name: ParentStep
schema.Description: The multi-step this step sits in (pko:isStepOfMultiStep).

schema.name: FirstChildStep
schema.Description: For a multi-step, its first sub-step (pko:hasFirstStep).

schema.name: VerifiesStep
schema.Description: For a verification step, the step it checks (pko:isStepVerificationOf).

schema.name: RemedyForError
schema.Description: Error this step remedies (pko:addressesError).

schema.name: CallsProcedure
schema.Description: Sub-procedure this step invokes.

schema.name: IsolatesEnergySource
schema.Description: Energy source this step isolates.

schema.name: PrerequisiteStep
schema.Description: Step whose completion this step requires first (the requires relation).

schema.name: MinRepetitions
schema.Description: Minimum times the step runs in one execution (pko:minRepetitions).

schema.name: MaxRepetitions
schema.Description: Maximum times the step may run in one execution (pko:maxRepetitions).

schema.name: Description
schema.Description: Longer description of the step (dct:description).

schema.name: ChildStepCount
schema.Description: Sub-steps of this step.

schema.name: ParentStepKind
schema.Description: Kind of the parent step.

schema.name: IsCompositeWithoutChildren
schema.Description: TRUE for a step declared MultiStep that has no sub-steps.

schema.name: PreconditionCount
schema.Description: Preconditions.

schema.name: PostconditionCount
schema.Description: Postconditions.

schema.name: InvariantCount
schema.Description: Invariants.

schema.name: SafetyCriticalConditionCount
schema.Description: Safety-critical conditions.

schema.name: FailureModeCount
schema.Description: Documented failure modes.

schema.name: CueCount
schema.Description: Cues a practitioner reads during the step.

schema.name: DangerCueCount
schema.Description: Danger cues that call for escalation.

schema.name: DecisionPointCount
schema.Description: Decision points.

schema.name: KnowledgeFragmentCount
schema.Description: Knowledge fragments attached to the step.

schema.name: HasInstructionOnly
schema.Description: TRUE for a step that carries only its one-line instruction: no condition, cue, failure mode, decision or captured knowledge.

schema.name: InputVariableCount
schema.Description: Declared input variables.

schema.name: OutputVariableCount
schema.Description: Declared output variables (what the step produces).

schema.name: RequiredLockCount
schema.Description: Locks the step requires.

schema.name: RequiredProtectiveEquipmentCount
schema.Description: Protective equipment the step requires.

schema.name: IsIsolationWithoutLock
schema.Description: TRUE when a step isolates an energy source but requires no lock to hold the isolation.

schema.name: ReferencedResourceCount
schema.Description: Resources the step references.

schema.name: UntypedVersionKey
schema.Description: Version key for a step with no ontology type.

schema.name: IsAccountableToSoftware
schema.Description: TRUE when the role accountable for the step is held by software or an AI agent.

schema.name: HasDownstreamSteps
schema.Description: TRUE when any step follows this one anywhere along the ordering chain.

schema.name: IncompletenessCueCount
schema.Description: Cues that show the step did not fully take effect.

schema.name: HasIncompletenessCue
schema.Description: TRUE when the step documents a cue that shows it did not fully take effect.

schema.name: HasPostcondition
schema.Description: TRUE when the step states what must hold after it.

schema.name: AccountableAgent
schema.Description: Agent currently holding the step's role.

schema.name: HasNoAccountableAgent
schema.Description: TRUE when nobody currently holds the role accountable for the step.

schema.name: ConditionlessVersionKey
schema.Description: Version key for a step with no precondition.

schema.name: PrerequisiteDownstreamCount
schema.Description: Closure pairs showing the step's prerequisite comes after it in the specified order.

schema.name: PrerequisiteIsDownstream
schema.Description: TRUE when the specification orders a step before the step it requires, so following the order is unsafe.

schema.name: StatesOperationalKnowledge
schema.Description: TRUE when the step states all three things the operational level needs: what it follows, what it depends on, and what must hold first.

schema.name: BottleneckAllocationCount
schema.Description: Resources allocated to the step whose demand exceeds capacity.

schema.name: IsBottleneckStep
schema.Description: TRUE when the step waits on a resource whose demand exceeds its capacity.

schema.name: Stage
schema.Description: Stage the step is grouped in.

schema.name: DetailLevel
schema.Description: Activity (bundles many actions), Task, or Action (a single physical or system action).

schema.name: CoarseTopLevelVersionKey
schema.Description: Version key for a top-level step at Activity detail.

schema.name: FineTopLevelVersionKey
schema.Description: Version key for a top-level step at Action detail.

schema.name: ContextSensitivityCount
schema.Description: Recorded ways the step's significance depends on context.

schema.name: UnscopedSensitivityCount
schema.Description: Context dependencies with no applicability scope.

schema.name: IsContextSensitiveButUnscoped
schema.Description: TRUE when the step's significance depends on context and some such dependency says nowhere where it holds.

schema.name: VersionProcedure
schema.Description: Procedure the step's version belongs to.

schema.name: AssignedRoleDoesComplianceReview
schema.Description: Whether the step's role carries the compliance-review capability.

schema.name: ComplianceReviewProcedureKey
schema.Description: Procedure key for a step performed by a compliance-review role.

schema.name: StepProcedureType
schema.Description: Procedure type of the step's version.

schema.name: IsReleaseApprovalGate
schema.Description: TRUE for an approval gate in a software release procedure.

schema.name: RegulatoryRequirementCount
schema.Description: Requirements on the step that a regulation imposes.

schema.name: ToolFunctionCount
schema.Description: Functions an agent may invoke at the step.

schema.name: ParseableConditionCount
schema.Description: Conditions stored as machine-parseable expressions.

schema.name: DmnDecisionCount
schema.Description: Decision points encoded as DMN decisions.

schema.name: ToolUseRulesOnlyInProse
schema.Description: TRUE for a step where an agent uses tools but no condition or decision is stored in parseable form.

schema.name: OpenOutdatedFlagCount
schema.Description: Open practitioner flags that the step's guidance is outdated.

schema.name: HasReportedRealityMismatch
schema.Description: TRUE for a step practitioners' feedback says no longer matches how the work is done.

schema.name: DeviatedRunCount
schema.Description: Executions of the step that recorded a deviation.

schema.name: IsDriftedFromPractice
schema.Description: TRUE when practice deviates from the step repeatedly, or deviates where practitioners flagged the guidance outdated.

schema.name: AiFailureCount
schema.Description: Failed AI assistant tasks during this step.

schema.name: IsAiFailurePoint
schema.Description: TRUE for a step where an AI assistant has failed a task.

schema.name: AiArtifactInputCount
schema.Description: Inputs fed by an artifact an AI agent's step produces.

schema.name: ConsumesAiAgentArtifact
schema.Description: TRUE when the step takes an AI agent's artifact as an input.

schema.name: CollectionEvidenceCount
schema.Description: Traces from this step to collected material, in any role.

schema.name: HasCollectionEvidence
schema.Description: TRUE when the step traces to at least one collected material.

schema.name: ActivityOriginTraceCount
schema.Description: Origin traces of this step as an activity definition.

schema.name: VersionModelTraceCount
schema.Description: Origin traces of the step's process model.

schema.name: IsUntracedActivityInTracedModel
schema.Description: TRUE when the step belongs to a traced process model but its own definition traces to no collection.

schema.name: ElicitedValidationCount
schema.Description: Validations of this step captured from people.

schema.name: ElicitedExtensionCount
schema.Description: Extensions of this step captured from people.

schema.name: DownstreamArtifactStepCount
schema.Description: Steps reachable from this step along artifact hand-offs.

schema.name: IsDeclaredFirstStep
schema.Description: TRUE for the step its version declares as its first step.

schema.name: IsDeclaredFallbackStep
schema.Description: TRUE for the step its version declares as its fallback step.

schema.name: DeclaredFirstStepKey
schema.Description: Step key when declared first.

schema.name: DeclaredFallbackStepKey
schema.Description: Step key when declared the fallback.

schema.name: OwnerOrganization
schema.Description: The organization that owns the procedure this row belongs to, one hop at a time from Procedures.OwnerOrganization. A row policy compares it to the caller's organization, so a plant sign-in never sees the finance close.

data.Title: Freeze transaction entry
data.Instruction: Lock subledgers and prevent late postings.
data.Name: 01. Freeze transaction entry

data.Title: Extract trial balance and feed timestamps
data.Instruction: Extract the trial balance and source-system timestamps.
data.Name: 02. Extract trial balance and feed timestamps

data.Title: Reconcile material accounts
data.Instruction: Reconcile material accounts and attach evidence.
data.Name: 03. Reconcile material accounts

data.Title: Classify and investigate variances
data.Instruction: Use AI triage, then apply human situated judgment to material or anomalous variances.
data.Name: 04. Classify and investigate variances

data.Title: Controller review
data.Instruction: Independently review reconciliations, evidence, and unresolved items.
data.Name: 05. Controller review

data.Title: CFO approval
data.Instruction: Approve the close package or return it with required corrections.
data.Name: 06. CFO approval

data.Title: Post close and publish package
data.Instruction: Post approved entries and publish the reporting package.
data.Name: 07. Post close and publish package

data.Title: Archive evidence and hold retrospective
data.Instruction: Archive evidence and capture questions, issues, and lessons learned.
data.Name: 08. Archive evidence and hold retrospective

data.Title: Identify policy trigger and affected population
data.Instruction: Establish the legal/business trigger and population affected.
data.Name: 01. Identify policy trigger and affected population

data.Title: Elicit process and practitioner knowledge
data.Instruction: Interview practitioners, inspect source artifacts, and record tacit/implicit/explicit knowledge.
data.Name: 02. Elicit process and practitioner knowledge

data.Title: Draft policy and channel variants
data.Instruction: Draft the policy and proposed email/SMS variants from approved sources.
data.Name: 03. Draft policy and channel variants

data.Title: Legal and privacy review
data.Instruction: Review legal commitments, privacy, consent, retention, and jurisdictional requirements.
data.Name: 04. Legal and privacy review

data.Title: Human authority approval
data.Instruction: Approve the policy meaning and all channel constraints.
data.Name: 05. Human authority approval

data.Title: Generate approved communications
data.Instruction: Render approved email and SMS messages without changing policy meaning.
data.Name: 06. Generate approved communications

data.Title: Apply channel controls and send
data.Instruction: Enforce consent, quiet hours, opt-out text, recipient scope, and delivery logging.
data.Name: 07. Apply channel controls and send

data.Title: Collect acknowledgements and exceptions
data.Instruction: Collect acknowledgements and create exception tasks for unreachable recipients.
data.Name: 08. Collect acknowledgements and exceptions

data.Title: Review feedback and update knowledge
data.Instruction: Review questions, feedback, delivery failures, and proposed knowledge changes.
data.Name: 09. Review feedback and update knowledge

data.Title: Prepare the work order and identify energy sources
data.Instruction: Confirm the work order and list every energy source on the machine.
data.Description: Uses the isolation map for the machine being serviced.
data.Name: 01. Prepare the work order and identify energy sources

data.Title: Notify affected employees
data.Instruction: Tell operators and nearby staff the machine is going down.
data.Name: 02. Notify affected employees

data.Title: Shut the equipment down
data.Instruction: Stop the machine through its normal controls.
data.Name: 03. Shut the equipment down

data.Title: Isolate every energy source
data.Instruction: Isolate each energy source in turn.
data.Name: 04. Isolate every energy source

data.Title: Open and lock the electrical disconnect
data.Instruction: Open the main disconnect and fit the breaker lockout.
data.Name: 04a. Open and lock the electrical disconnect

data.Title: Close and bleed the pneumatic supply
data.Instruction: Close the supply valve, fit the valve lockout and bleed the line.
data.Name: 04b. Close and bleed the pneumatic supply

data.Title: Block raised sections against gravity
data.Instruction: Lower or block every raised conveyor section.
data.Name: 04c. Block raised sections against gravity

data.Title: Apply personal locks and tags
data.Instruction: Each person working on the machine applies their own lock and tag.
data.Name: 05. Apply personal locks and tags

data.Title: Verify the zero-energy state
data.Instruction: Read every gauge and try the start button; nothing may move or hiss.
data.Name: 06. Verify the zero-energy state

data.Title: Perform the maintenance
data.Instruction: Carry out the work order.
data.Name: 07. Perform the maintenance

data.Title: Remove locks and restore energy
data.Instruction: Each person removes only their own lock, then energy is restored.
data.Name: 08. Remove locks and restore energy

data.Title: Escalate residual energy and re-isolate
data.Instruction: Keep locks on, escalate to the safety officer and re-isolate.
data.Name: 09. Escalate residual energy and re-isolate

data.Title: Shut down the machine
data.Instruction: Stop the machine.
data.Name: 01. Shut down the machine

data.Title: Apply locks
data.Instruction: Put locks on.
data.Name: 02. Apply locks

data.Title: Disconnect power
data.Instruction: Cut main power.
data.Name: 03. Disconnect power

data.Title: Do the maintenance
data.Instruction: Do the work.
data.Name: 04. Do the maintenance

data.Title: Inspect belt and roller wear
data.Instruction: Inspect the belt.
data.Name: 01. Inspect belt and roller wear

data.Title: Lock out the line
data.Instruction: Run the lockout procedure.
data.Name: 02. Lock out the line

data.Title: Replace worn rollers
data.Instruction: Replace rollers.
data.Name: 03. Replace worn rollers
